text:
Elena G.: quick heads-up — marketplace launch is now targeted for next Friday. we need final driver/CUDA/ROCm pins for partner images by EOD Tue. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ravi P.: noted. can we standardize on one NVIDIA/CUDA combo + one ROCm combo for all marketplace SKUs? reduces matrix size.
Tess (Partner-HW): +1 from our side. prefer NVIDIA 535.x + CUDA 12.2 for cloud-certified image. for ROCm, we validated 5.6 on our infra but can re-run 5.7 if needed.
Chris M.: to avoid regressions we should pin drivers and also include a fallback policy: if runtime detects perf/regression, fallback to previous model variant and emit alert.
Nina L.: marketing needs a firm compatibility statement. can we commit to a supported stack list we can publish? also need a short blurb for the joint announcement.
Elena G.: yes — publishable compatibility list will be the pinned combos we sign off on Tue. draft blurb: "Redwood Inference validated on NVIDIA 535 + CUDA 12.2 and ROCm 5.7 across major cloud partners; consult support for air-gapped configs." opinions?
Ravi P.: small tweak: call out kernel baseline for ROCm (6.1) and NV driver minimum kernel tested (5.15+). avoids surprises.
Tess (Partner-HW): confirmed on our side: ROCm 5.7 + kernel 6.1 passes perf and memory regressions on our test harness. we can sign off if Redwood runs the compatibility test suite once after pins are set.
Chris M.: I'll run the compatibility suite on dedicated infra Wed morning. results posted as a short table in this thread. if anything fails, we open a hotfix ticket and pause the marketplace rollout.
ops-bot: Deploy helper created branch: release/marketplace-stack-pins-1769998888 and CI job "compat-suite/marketplace" queued.
Nina L.: thanks — once Chris posts results we'll turn that into the "validated stacks" appendix for the announcement. any legal/partner review items?
Elena G.: legal looped in earlier, they want the exact version numbers in the appendix and a note about optional pinned workarounds for on-prem customers.
Ravi P.: action items: 1) Chris run compat suite Wed AM; 2) Tess confirm partner re-run Wed PM; 3) Elena assemble publishable list + blurb Wed evening.
Tess (Partner-HW): we'll target Wed evening for signoff. if we find a regression we propose a hotfix driver tag and a rollback window.
Chris M.: will report results here by 1700 PST Wed. if any regression -> create ticket in #eng-runtime and ping @Ravi @Tess.
Elena G.: perfect. thanks everyone. small note — please avoid changing base images after Tue to keep the test matrix stable. :lock:
Nina L.: copying this into the announcement doc and the partner QA checklist.
Elena G.: closing loop for now. I'll post the final pinned list once Chris confirms. :white_check_mark:
